descriptionChirho: An Aramaic noun meaning 'tongue' in the sense of a spoken language or linguistic group, used in Daniel and Ezra to enumerate peoples and nations. The two clusters differ only in grammatical number — plural 'and languages' (eng: and languages, spa: y lenguas, hin: और भाषाओं, arb: وَالأَلْسِنَةِ, kor: 그리고 언어들이, swa: na lugha) versus singular 'and language' (eng: and language, spa: y lengua, hin: और भाषा, arb: وَلِسَانٍ). Both denote the same concept of a spoken tongue.
